__inputs.name: DS_AZURE_MONITOR
__inputs.label: Existing Azure Monitor data source
__inputs.description: Select an authorized existing data source. No paid Grafana resource is created.

title: Azure SQL POC — optional observation template

options.content: Configure an existing Azure Monitor data source and enter resource IDs locally. Confirm metric export/table schemas first. SQL percentages are exported maxima; blank data is not proof of health. Do not commit the configured dashboard.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceId =~ '${sqlResource}'
| where MetricName in ('cpu_percent','physical_data_read_percent','log_write_percent','workers_percent','sessions_percent')
| summarize Value=max(Maximum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), MetricName
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
